name: The Deep (Vissidal)
title: The Deep (Vissidal)
summary: The Deep (Vissidal) is an amorphous haze on Vissidal that accepts gold trophies (Gold Shallows Shredder, Gold Moarsman...) for experience and the Servant of the Deep title. At its coordinates the kit shows a visible landmark: a round, moss-covered spire structure (model 0x01003D10, 24 m across, 18.4 m tall, open layout) with portalspace-rift lights at its south mouth, on the flat moss plain of Mosswart Marsh, an hourglass-shaped Empyrean sculpture and mossy rocks beside it. The same structure marks The Deep on Dark Isle and Vaeshok's Cave.
insertNote: Kept the batch's route position (chapter ch2).

shots.standingOrder: Rise from 2 m to 5.5 m above the moss 17 m south of The Deep's twisted spire, keeping its south mouth and the portalspace rifts centred; keep 7 m from the mossy rock to the west.
